label.purpose: Month names, board add-buttons, the legend.

shadows.name: marker-lift
shadows.purpose: Under balance-marker dots only; lifts the marker off the wedge.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and selection state changes; nothing choreographed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single accent action: save, confirm, sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.45 0.13 255)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.005 250)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.55 0.1 255)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recorded Item Card
components.description: An entry that actually happened. Solid border = real.
components.css: .ds-card-recorded { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; width: 200px; padding: 4px 6px; background: oklch(0.52 0.11 152 / 0.12); border: 1px solid oklch(0.52 0.11 152 / 0.6); border-radius: 3px; color: oklch(0.46 0.1 152); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-card-recorded:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-card-name { font: 500 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-amount { font: 600 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Planned Item Card
components.description: An expected item. Dashed border = not yet real.
components.css: .ds-card-planned { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; width: 200px; padding: 4px 6px; background: oklch(0.45 0.015 250 / 0.04); border: 1px dashed oklch(0.45 0.015 250 / 0.35); border-radius: 3px; color: oklch(0.45 0.015 250 / 0.9); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-planned:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-card-planned .ds-card-name { font: 500 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-planned .ds-card-amount { font: 600 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Month Band
components.description: The horizon: month label, projected balance, delta chip.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 220px; height: 44px; background: oklch(0.32 0.015 255); border-block: 1px solid oklch(0.912 0.006 250 / 0.5); } .ds-band-month { font: 500 10px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); } .ds-band-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-band-total { font: 600 13px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #fff; } .ds-band-delta { font: 400 10px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-band-delta-neg { color: oklch(0.81 0.11 22); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: shadcn default on the token layer.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.21 0.012 250); background: oklch(0.999 0.002 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.912 0.006 250); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.5 0.014 250); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.1 255); outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview: The board is a landscape of months: income rises above a dark horizon line, spending hangs below it, and the projected balance rolls across the terrain as a shaded wedge. The horizon (the month band) is the instrument's dial: every number on it must be trustworthy at a glance. The system's personality is calm, precise, trustworthy, a reliable instrument in the register of Linear and the Stripe Dashboard, never a coach, never a toy.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers first: tabular numerals everywhere money appears
One accent (ink-blue) for actions and 'you are here', ≤10% of any screen
Solid means recorded, dashed means planned
Light is the designed default; dark is fully tokened

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ink-blue is the only non-semantic color and covers ≤10% of any screen. If blue appears anywhere that isn't an action, a selection, or the user's position, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Semantic Lock Rule
rules.body: Green, graphite, and red belong to money states exclusively. They are prohibited on chrome, headings, icons, or decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every currency amount renders with tabular-nums. Proportional digits in a money column are a defect.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. If a card needs a shadow to be findable, its layout is wrong.

dos: Do set every amount in tabular-nums with an explicit sign (+/−) and $ prefix.
Do keep dashed-vs-solid as the only encoding of planned-vs-recorded.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 250; chroma between 0.003 and 0.015.
Do keep the band at a fixed y across all twelve columns under all data.
donts: Don't use generic fintech SaaS styling: navy/gold gradients, hero-metric cards, glassmorphism.
Don't drift toward toy budgeting apps: mascots, confetti, gamified streaks, emoji as UI icons.
Don't rebuild corporate banking portal density: gray bureaucratic forms, compliance-heavy tables.
Don't use border-left thicker than 1px as a colored accent; side stripes are prohibited.
Don't put green, graphite, or red on anything that isn't money.
